name: IPA-BPE Phonetic Tokenizer + Competitive Stack
author: Naledi
blurb: Novel phonetic tokenization (IPA-BPE) combined with int6 STE QAT, BigramHash, SmearGate, OrthoInit, MLP 3x, and tuned hyperparameters. First known phonetic tokenizer submission. Tested on 4xH100 (non-record). Model currently over 16MB budget due to MLP 3x + BigramHash — int6 export quantization needed to fit.
artifact_bytes_note: 19.5MB with int8+zlib — over 16MB limit. Needs int6 export to fit.
